answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 19 keys loses far more than 19 single identities would. The vine graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the river audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the zenith checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
